proof_scope: live acoustic audibility of voice_delivery tags against the renderer own same-parameter noise floor plus receipt-readback pace proof, receipt honesty, and retained emotional-quality/variety checks for non-robotic Chatterbox renders

claims.proves: pace publishes applied phase-vocoder receipts with output duration scaling, while intensity/valence and tone-with-emotion_realization=audible produce wav-measured acoustic separation exceeding the same-parameter noise floor; the tone_matrix case classifies every declared tone and publishes the pairwise matrix; the emotional_quality_variety case renders tender/guarded/playful utterances and checks waveform pause realization, clipping, signal, pitch variation, duration, and cross-utterance variety; the default tone path is not silently claimed as applied in /health
claims.does_not_prove: human-perceived emotional quality (chatterbox#7), real speaker emotion, full ASR fidelity, or behavior when the server is down

cases.name: pace-separation
tone-alone-default-path-stays-inert-as-declared
command: import json, urllib.request; h=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8018/health', timeout=30)); tone=h['voice_delivery_effect']['fields']['tone']; ok=(tone.get('status')!='applied' or 'audible' in json.dumps(tone).lower()); print(json.dumps({'case':'tone_alone_declaration','tone':tone,'pass':ok}, indent=1)); print('RESULT: PASS (tone_alone_declaration)' if ok else 'RESULT: FAIL (tone_alone_declaration)'); raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
